mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the GDP growth rate (GDPC1) below its 5-year moving average signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: If the GDP growth rate remains below its 5-year moving average for 6 months but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals an acceleration in economic activity, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased corporate earnings potential.
failure_condition: If industrial production rises above its 12-month moving average for 3 months but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary policy, which historically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to higher discount rates and reduced corporate borrowing.
failure_condition: If the federal funds rate rises above 4.5% for 2 months but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tightening labor market, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased consumer spending and corporate profit margins.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate falls below 5.0% for 3 months but S&P 500 forward returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below its 12-month moving average signals a slowdown in residential construction, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and economic activity.
failure_condition: If housing starts fall below their 12-month moving average for 2 months but S&P 500 forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, the hypothesis is falsified.
